elle-and-emmett-couples-costume.title: The Elle and Emmett Couples Costume
elle-and-emmett-couples-costume.intro: The couples costume where she does the heavy lifting and he just has to own a corduroy blazer. A hot pink mini, pink slingbacks and a quilted pink bag for her, the brown blazer for him, and you both know who ends up wearing it by the end of the night.

images.alt: Overhead flat lay on warm wood floorboards of a hot pink mini dress, a brown corduroy blazer, pink slingback heels, a quilted pink bag, gold heart huggies and a pink satin bow.
Woman on a farmhouse porch at Halloween in a hot pink mini dress with a brown corduroy blazer over her shoulders, pink slingbacks and a quilted pink bag, holding a pink tumbler.

last-minute-legally-blonde-costume.title: The Last-Minute Legally Blonde Costume
last-minute-legally-blonde-costume.intro: You do not need a new outfit, you need four things that make it obvious. A hot pink knit over your own jeans, a fluffy pen, a velvet scrunchie and a tiny chihuahua in a pink carrier, and everyone gets it before you say a word. Order it the week of the party and keep the sweater.

images.alt: Overhead flat lay on pale wood floorboards of a hot pink knit sweater on folded jeans, three fluffy pom pom pens, a plush chihuahua, a pink pet carrier bag and a hot pink velvet scrunchie.
Woman in a hot pink knit sweater and jeans sitting on porch steps writing with a fluffy pink pen, a plush chihuahua in a pink carrier beside her and a hot pink scrunchie in her hair.

pink-angel-halloween-costume.title: The Pink Angel Halloween Costume
pink-angel-halloween-costume.intro: Angelic, technically. A hot pink ruffle dress, pink feather wings and a fluffy halo, finished with white platforms and a rose clutch. It photographs like a dream and you can sit down in it, which is more than most costumes can say.

images.alt: That girl collage on blush pink of a hot pink ruffle dress, pink feather angel wings, a white feather halo, white platform heels, a pink rose clutch and silver star earrings.
Mirror selfie in a farmhouse hallway of a woman in a hot pink ruffle dress, pink feather angel wings and a white halo, holding a pink tumbler and a pink rose clutch.

pink-ballerina-halloween-costume.title: Pink Ballerina Halloween Costume You Can Rewear
pink-ballerina-halloween-costume.intro: A pink ballerina costume that does not live in a bin after October. The tutu is the fun part, but the wrap top, tights and satin flats are real wardrobe pieces. I wore it with leg warmers and an iced coffee, obviously.

images.alt: Overhead flat lay of a pink ballerina Halloween costume: pink tulle tutu, long sleeve wrap top, ribbed leg warmers, ballet pink tights and satin ballet flats on pink satin.
A woman in a pink tulle tutu, long sleeve ballet wrap top, ribbed leg warmers, pink tights and satin ballet flats, holding a glitter pink iced coffee tumbler with a lavender straw.

pink-bunny-halloween-costume.title: The Pink Bunny Halloween Costume
pink-bunny-halloween-costume.intro: The bunny costume is the one scene everybody remembers and almost nobody pulls off, because the shop versions look like a party-store bag. This one starts with a real pink corset mini dress you would wear again in December, then lets the ears, the bow tie collar and a fluffy heart bag do the costume part.

images.alt: Shoppable collage on white of a pink corset mini dress on a hanger, pink bunny ears, a white bow tie collar, cuffs, a tail, hot pink pumps, a fluffy heart bag, pearl earrings and pink pumpkins.
Mirror selfie of a woman in a pink corset mini dress, pink bunny ears, a white collar with pink bow tie, hot pink pumps and a fluffy heart bag, phone covering her face, pink gingham bed behind.

pink-car-interior-accessories.title: Pink Car Interior Accessories
pink-car-interior-accessories.intro: My car got the pink treatment and now every coffee run feels a little happier. A pink steering wheel cover, seat belt covers, coasters, vent clips, a phone holder and a tiny trash can. Small things, big difference.

images.alt: Overhead flat lay of pink car interior accessories: pink steering wheel cover, seat belt covers, small trash can, cup holder coasters, vent clips and a pink phone holder.

pink-cat-halloween-costume.title: The Pink Cat Halloween Costume
pink-cat-halloween-costume.intro: The cat costume, done warm enough for actual trick or treating. A pink puff sleeve sweater dress with thigh high socks and glitter ears, and the dress keeps working long after the candy is gone.

images.alt: Overhead flat lay on pink faux fur of a pink ribbed sweater dress, pink glitter cat ears, white thigh high socks, white bow flats, gold heart earrings, a pink heart bag and a pink pail.
Woman walking down farmhouse porch steps at dusk in a pink sweater dress, pink cat ears, white thigh high socks and bow flats, carrying a pink heart bag and tumbler.

pink-cowgirl-halloween-costume.title: The Pink Cowgirl Halloween Costume
pink-cowgirl-halloween-costume.intro: Everyone does the brown suede cowgirl. This one keeps the dress white and lets the hat, the boots and the fringe do the talking, so it reads Legally Blonde from across the room. The dress and boots are the pieces you will actually wear again.

images.alt: Overhead flat lay on white linen of a white ruffle mini dress, hot pink cowboy hat, pink western boots, pink fringe crossbody bag, star tassel earrings and a pink paisley bandana.
Mirror selfie of a woman in a white mini dress, hot pink cowboy hat, pink bandana, pink fringe crossbody bag and pink cowboy boots, phone covering her face, pink blanket on the bed behind.

pink-dog-halloween-finds.title: Pink Dog Halloween Finds
pink-dog-halloween-finds.intro: Your dog is coming to the party whether they like it or not, so they may as well match. A pink tutu, ghost and pumpkin bandanas, a pink harness and a treat jar for the bribes it will take to keep the tutu on.

images.alt: Overhead flat lay on a cream knit blanket of a pink dog tutu, pink ghost and pumpkin dog bandanas, a pink harness and leash, a pink treat jar and white plush ghost toys.

pink-dorm-halloween-decor.title: Pink Dorm Halloween Decor
pink-dorm-halloween-decor.intro: Most dorms ban real candles and nails in the wall, which kills half of what Pinterest calls Halloween decor. This list works inside those rules: flameless tea lights, fairy lights, stick-on bats and soft things that pack flat in November.

images.alt: Overhead photo of a cream dorm bed with pink ghost pillows, a pink ghost and bat throw, pink paper bats, pink flameless tea lights, pink star fairy lights and two pink ghost glass mugs.

pink-fairy-halloween-costume.title: Pink Fairy Halloween Costume
pink-fairy-halloween-costume.intro: If you want a costume that photographs like a dream, go fairy. Glitter wings, a flower crown, a sequin tank and a tulle skirt come together in minutes. The tank and the glitter flats are easy to wear again.

images.alt: Overhead flat lay of a pink fairy Halloween costume: glitter pink fairy wings and wand, flower crown, hot pink sequin tank, layered sparkle tulle skirt and glitter ballet flats.
A woman wearing glitter pink fairy wings, a flower crown, hot pink sequin tank, sparkle tulle skirt and glitter flats, holding a glitter pink iced coffee tumbler with a lavender straw.

pink-flamingo-office-halloween-costume.title: Pink Flamingo Office Halloween Costume
pink-flamingo-office-halloween-costume.intro: I wanted a Halloween costume I could actually wear to work, so I went with a flamingo. A dusty rose midi dress, a fluffy pink fascinator and little flamingo earrings, and nobody has to know it is a costume until they look closely. Most of it stays in my closet after October.

images.alt: Overhead flat lay of a pink flamingo office Halloween costume: dusty rose midi dress, pink feather fascinator, satin Mary Jane flats, pink tights, bow bag and flamingo earrings.

pink-graduation-gown-halloween-costume.title: The Pink Graduation Gown Costume
pink-graduation-gown-halloween-costume.intro: The bunny suit gets all the attention, but the graduation scene is the one people quote. A pink cap and gown over satin heels, pearls and a hot pink bow is instantly readable, office-party safe, and easy to put on in five minutes.

images.alt: Shoppable collage on white of a pink graduation cap and gown, blush satin heels, pearl drop earrings, two hot pink satin hair bows, a pink floral clutch and pink peonies.
A woman walking away on a leafy brick campus path in a pink graduation cap and gown, blush heels, a hot pink hair bow, holding a pink clutch and a bunch of pink peonies, glancing back.

pink-halloween-party-decor.title: Pink Halloween Party Decor
pink-halloween-party-decor.intro: Halloween does not have to be black and orange to count. Hot pink pumpkins, ghost print tablecloths and tall pink candles make a table people photograph before they eat. Spooky is optional. Cute is the point.

images.alt: Overhead photo of a pink ghost print tablecloth with hot pink pumpkins, pink, purple and black balloons, a sheet of ghost window clings and four hot pink taper candles.

pink-halloween-porch-decor.title: Pink Halloween Porch Decor
pink-halloween-porch-decor.intro: A pink porch reads cute from the street and still says Halloween the second someone walks up the steps. Velvet pumpkins carry it into November, the ghost sign and the doormat do the spooky part, and the candy basket means you never hunt for a bowl again.

pink-pageant-queen-halloween-costume.title: Pink Pageant Queen Halloween Costume
pink-pageant-queen-halloween-costume.intro: Some Halloweens call for a crown. A pink satin gown, a crystal tiara, opera gloves and hot pink heels make a pageant queen in five pieces, and the gown and heels come back out for the next fancy occasion.

images.alt: Overhead flat lay of a pink pageant queen Halloween costume: pink satin maxi gown, crystal tiara, long satin opera gloves, pleated satin clutch and hot pink strappy heels.
A woman in a pink satin maxi gown with a crystal tiara, long satin opera gloves, pleated clutch and hot pink heels, holding a glitter pink iced coffee tumbler with a lavender straw.

pink-sequin-mini-dress-halloween-costume.title: The Pink Sequin Mini Dress Costume
pink-sequin-mini-dress-halloween-costume.intro: Sequins are not subtle and this costume does not pretend to be. A hot pink mini with sheer sleeves, silver heels you can actually stand in, and heart sunglasses for the one photo everyone will ask you to send them. It is a costume on the thirty-first and a birthday dress the rest of the year.

images.alt: Shoppable collage of a hot pink sequin mini dress, silver glitter kitten heels, pink heart sunglasses, hot pink tassel earrings, a rose gold glitter clutch and two pink pumpkins.

pink-sorority-girl-halloween-costume.intro: The easiest costume of the season is a cropped pink hoodie, a tennis skirt and a pair of striped knee socks. Add platform high tops and a canvas tote and you are ready for a campus party. Everything works again for fall weekends.

images.alt: Overhead flat lay of a pink sorority girl Halloween costume: pastel pink cropped hoodie, pleated tennis skirt, striped knee high socks, platform sneakers and a pink canvas tote.
A woman walking away on a leafy fall campus path in a pink cropped hoodie, pleated tennis skirt, striped knee socks and platform sneakers, carrying a pink tote and iced coffee.

pink-suit-law-student-halloween-costume.title: The Pink Suit Law Student Costume
pink-suit-law-student-halloween-costume.intro: The pink suit is the only costume that works at a party and in a meeting the week after. Hot pink, fitted, buttoned properly, with pearls and a velvet headband doing the heavy lifting. If you are going to be the law student in pink, commit to the suit.

images.alt: Overhead flat lay on white linen of a hot pink skirt suit, pink patent pumps, a pink satchel, a pearl necklace, a pink velvet headband, a laptop sleeve and two pink mini pumpkins.

pink-witch-halloween-costume.title: The Pink Witch Halloween Costume
pink-witch-halloween-costume.intro: The witch costume, minus the green face paint and the cape you trip over. A black velvet mini does the heavy lifting, the pink velvet hat and lace gloves make it read as a costume, and every piece except the hat goes straight back into your closet for holiday parties.

Mirror selfie in a farmhouse hallway of a woman in a black velvet mini dress, pink velvet witch hat, pink lace gloves and black Mary Janes, holding a pink tumbler.

pink-workwear-freezing-office.title: Pink Workwear for a Freezing Office
pink-workwear-freezing-office.intro: Every office has one thermostat and it is set for penguins. This is the fix: a soft pink cable cardigan over wide leg trousers, loafers you can walk to the train in, and a tote that fits the laptop. Soft and pink was never the opposite of competent.
